$comment: Machine-generated public surface of pkinative (the single entry point src/index.ts) — the ground truth for agents, since dist/*.d.ts is not committed. Fields that cannot be read mechanically are null, never guessed; `throws` lists the @throws classes of a function. Regenerate with `npm run docs:api`; the verify-docs rule api-json-sync enforces freshness.
